test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
What fraction of space will a spherical ball of radius 2.1 cm take in a big spherical container of diameter of 84 cm? 

Take pi = frac{22}7
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the spherical ball = 2.1 cm

Diameter of the spherical container = 84 cm

Radius of the spherical container = 84 / 2 = 42 cm

**Formula Used:**

Fraction of space taken = Volume of the spherical ball / Volume of the spherical container

Volume of a sphere = (4/3) x π x r³

**Calculation:**

Volume of the spherical ball = (4/3) x (22/7) x (2.1)³

⇒ (4/3) x (22/7) x 2.1 x 2.1 x 2.1

⇒ (4/3) x (22/7) x 9.261

⇒ (4 x 22 x 9.261) / (3 x 7)

⇒ 814.968 / 21

⇒ 38.812 cm³

Volume of the spherical container = (4/3) x (22/7) x (42)³

⇒ (4/3) x (22/7) x 42 x 42 x 42

⇒ (4/3) x (22/7) x 74088

⇒ (4 x 22 x 74088) / (3 x 7)

⇒ 6515712 / 21

⇒ 310272 cm³

Fraction of space taken = Volume of the spherical ball / Volume of the spherical container

⇒ 38.812 / 310272

⇒ 1 / 8000

**The fraction of space taken by the spherical ball is 1/8000.**

Radius of spherical container = 8.4/2 =4.2

** Fraction of space = frac {2.1 times 2.1 times 2.}{42 times 42 times 42} = 1 / 8000.**
